utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tell Kira I’m still good for Saturday around 10 at the community center, and I can haul whatever’s first on the list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks for confirming, Leo—can you just confirm whether you’re also handling the signup sheet, or only hauling whatever’s first on the list?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Only hauling for now—I’m still good for Saturday around 10 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Jules, I’m glad folks are offering gear, but I need the list nailed down first—who’s bringing what, pickup times, and where it’s all being stored so nothing walks off.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good call, Pia—I’m asking around both sides this afternoon, so I’ll send you a clear list of who’s bringing what, when it’s getting picked up, and where we’re keeping it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, Jules, that’s what I need—once I can see the list, I’ll feel a lot better about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mara, just so we’re aligned, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center; if you can flag any homes that should be on the list, I’ll fold them in this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I’m already sorting the donated tools and tracking what needs parts, and I’ll send over any homes I think we should add this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a big help, Mara — thank you. Once your notes come through, I’ll add those homes to the Sunday community center list and make sure nothing slips through.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do you know who had the clipboard last, or who’s supposed to be running the signup list?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, sorry—I blanked for a second. I’m not sure who had the clipboard last, but we’re still meeting by the community center, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, we’re still meeting there, but who should we ask first about that clipboard if nobody knows where it went?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s the hope—Jules is asking around both sides this afternoon, and I’m still spreading the word while I’m out, so it should shape up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect—I’ll keep repeating that it’s the repair drive, what to bring, and when it starts this afternoon, and send anyone interested your way too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik—that helps a lot. Between you, Jules, and me getting the word around, I think we’ll have a solid crowd this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, still by the community center. I’ll stop by, just keeping to myself a bit today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s alright, Uli—just so you know, Sam’s set to grab Gus’s ladder and drill, and Kira’s only waiting on who’s handling the signup sheet and timing before she settles easy.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright. If nobody’s taken it, I can keep the signup sheet and timing sorted when I get there—just may be a little quiet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard second-hand that about eight homes are signed up so far, and I still don’t know who’s actually coordinating the signup list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m keeping the plan simple, Nell—I’m the point person for now, and Rey’s bringing the list by after with the start time and what folks should bring so we can look it over.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps—I’d only been hearing bits and pieces second-hand. Once Rey brings the list, can you let me know if they’ve started going door to door yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, Rosa’s sending me the short list this afternoon, and I’ll skim it for any houses that need a repair flag or check-in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good deal, Bo—tell Pia I’ve still got my ladder and drill set aside, and I can bring ’em to the church shed Saturday morning once we know who’s checking them out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ll pass that to Pia, and once Rosa’s list comes through I’ll just flag anything that jumps out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we lock anything in for the repair drive, do we know who’s actually managing the signup list and who last had the clipboard?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m late — Quinn’s handling the signup confirmations from Maple and Cedar, and I can take back the clipboard once we figure out who had it last.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That helps, thanks — before we move the clipboard, do you know who had it most recently, or should we ask Quinn first since they’re handling the signup confirmations?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got Noah marked for one roll of tape and two pairs of gloves, and I’m still leaving trash bags unchecked until he confirms.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still waiting on Quinn’s Maple and Cedar confirmations, and once those houses are locked in I’ll map them by stretch so we can line your supplies up against the block.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—once Quinn’s Maple and Cedar confirmations are in, send me the block breakdown and I’ll match the tape, gloves, and trash bags to each stretch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can cover the tool-check right after drop-off, and I should be able to swing by again before pickup if you still need me then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Faye—that helps a lot. I think Cleo’s got me down for tape and two pairs of gloves already, but I’m still fuzzy on the trash bags.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should be fine—I can check on the trash bags when I stop by after drop-off and make sure we’ve got enough before pickup too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m making the rounds on Maple and Cedar this afternoon, Sam, and I’ll send you the houses that say yes so we can keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn—that helps a lot. Send me the yeses when you have them, and I’ll keep the tool pickup moving on my end.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it, Sam—I’ll start with Maple and Cedar this afternoon and pass along the confirmed houses as soon as I’ve got them.
